description: Pitch quantizer for three voices at once, working over a two-octave grid of notes you switch on and off, with a tuning offset in cents for every one of the twenty-four

params.text: Sets how far the incoming pitch is stretched before it is quantised: flattened to one note at the bottom of its travel, unchanged in the middle, and spread over twice the range at the top
Shifts the incoming pitch before quantising, one semitone down at the bottom of its travel to one semitone up at the top

inputs.text: A pitch to be quantised; each channel of a polyphonic cable is quantised on its own
A pitch to be quantised; each channel of a polyphonic cable is quantised on its own
A pitch to be quantised; each channel of a polyphonic cable is quantised on its own
Added to the amount knob, a fifth of a unit per volt
Added to the offset knob, a whole unit per volt, so 1V shifts the incoming pitch by a semitone

outputs.text: The quantised pitch of the jack beside it, one volt per octave, with that note's cent offset added

notes: the twenty-four rows down the panel are the note grid, two octaves of it, with the higher octave above the dividing line.
click the small square at the left of a row to switch that note in or out, and drag the bar beside it to tune that note in cents.
a click on a note row cannot reach this help, because the rows are one display widget rather than separate controls.
the other twenty-four microtune presets cover maqam, makam, dastgah and raga tunings, Slendro, Pelog, Thai 7-TET and Chinese Pentatonic.
menu: Scale Presets: Chromatic, Major, Minor, Penta Major, Penta Minor, Dorian, Phrygian, Lydian, Mixolydian, Locrian, Major Triad, Minor Triad, Blues, Arabic, Japanese, Whole Tone — the note grid
Microtune Presets: Equal Temperament, Just Intonation, Pythagorean, Quarter-tone — the first four of twenty-eight tunings, each setting the cent offset of every note at once
Directional (Asc/Desc): Turkish Rast, Arabic Hijaz, Miyako-bushi — three tunings that use one set of cents for a rising line and another for a falling one
